note: Terrain recipes written for MiniTracker (own words, common Citadel paints). Paint names must exist in the paint list.

terrain.name: Grey Imperial ruins
steps: Into the brickwork and cracks; it does not need to be neat.
Lighter, on edges and top surfaces.
Pick out some wooden beams and doors.
Low down on the walls, for dirt.

terrain.name: Rusted metal
steps: Patches of rust on panels and around bolts.
Streaks running down from bolts and edges.
A few bright scratches on edges.

terrain.name: Weathered wood
steps: Lighter, on edges and plank ends.

terrain.name: Sci-fi panels
steps: Spray or big brush over the panels.
A few chips on edges and corners.

terrain.name: Ice crystals
steps: Thin it with Contrast Medium so the bottom stays dark and the tips light.
Gloss, so it looks like ice.
